purpose: Teach: アタマ/境地/ワザ/実話/唖然/シリアス/ファイト/頭上

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはアタマが切れる方ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad is really sharp, you know.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost thinking aloud. Soft pace. Gentle pride threading underneath. A quiet smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが達人の境地に達したって仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he reached master level at cooking.
lines.style: Careful seriousness. Sho is relaying something important to him. Small pause before the big claim, like he's checking if Mom gets it too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの料理のワザを見て下さいね
lines.en: Sho, look at your dad's cooking technique—really watch.
lines.style: Encouraging and warm. Opening with light lift. Inviting him to see something she wants him to notice. Genuine delight underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、これは実話のドキュメンタリーだよ
lines.en: Mom, this is like a documentary about real things.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly amused by his own observation. Not performing—just noticing something true. Quiet conviction in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが値段を見て唖然とされてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was completely stunned when he saw the price.
lines.style: Light, wry amusement. Not unkind—affectionate teasing. Slight upturn at the end, inviting Sho to share the joke with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、シリアスなお話を真剣に聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I listened to Dad's serious story really carefully.
lines.style: Intent and sincere. Sho wants her to know he paid attention, that he cared. Steady pace. No rushing. The seriousness of a six-year-old committing to listen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがファイトと応援して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad cheered everyone on—gave us all his support.
lines.style: Soft warmth. Yumiko reliving a moment of her husband's generosity. Open, tender delivery. Slight breathiness on the emotional weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、頭上に虹が出てるよ
lines.en: Mom, there's a rainbow right above us!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick intake of breath at the start. Sho pointing upward with his voice. Genuine wonder—not performed, just seen.
